description: Change the login shell of a user account.
This determines the name of the user's initial login command.

option.name: --root
tip: Apply changes in the CHROOT_DIR directory and use the configuration files from the CHROOT_DIR directory.

option.name: --shell
tip: The name of the user's new login shell.
Setting this field to blank causes the system to select the default login shell.
The shell must be listed in /etc/shells unless the invoker is the superuser.
